_howto: startHere: the picks shown first on /emails, in this order, matched by subject (capitals don't matter). freeSamples: subjects anyone can read in full without being a patron, a taste of the archive (keep it to one or two). hide: subjects (or Kit ids) to leave out of the archive entirely. essays: emails that carried a published essay, as "email subject": "essay slug". Those show in the archive as an Essay and link to the essay page instead of an email copy. Save, then deploy.
